name: smwgraphics-actraiser-death-heim-stage-cleared
title: ActRaiser - Death Heim (Stage Cleared)
description:
The background seen when you finally clear ActRaiser. Compared to the original game, I took some liberties and lmade it loop, so it can be better used in SMW. The water itself is perfect for parallax scrolling.

A good fit for beach / ocean levels, in general.
